title: Isaiah Washington Confirms Wife's Death After a Year of Silence
seoTitle: Isaiah Washington Confirms Wife's Death After Silence
subtitle: Actor shares details about the hemorrhagic stroke that claimed Jenisa Garland
excerpt: Isaiah Washington used Instagram to confirm his wife Jenisa Garland's death after a hemorrhagic stroke in 2025, and warns about the severity of headaches.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: TV Insider, E! News, Us Weekly
contentHtml:
Actor Isaiah Washington broke his silence by posting on Instagram the confirmation of the death of his wife, Jenisa Garland, which occurred over a year ago. The announcement sparked great interest from the public, who are seeking to understand the circumstances of her passing.

Death announcement and details of the event

In a post published on October 3, Washington wrote that his wife of 29 years "suddenly collapsed on May 31, 2025" and passed away on June 9, 2025. He described the situation as "a great shock" for the entire family.

Cause: Hemorrhagic stroke and health warning

Washington reported that Jenisa succumbed to "a massive hemorrhagic stroke" and never recovered. The actor took the opportunity to warn his followers: "Some headaches aren't just migraines, they can be signs of something worse. Get a brain scan if you can and take the pain seriously."

Legacy of the children

The couple has three children – Tyme, Iman, and Isaiah V – who, according to Washington, continue their mother's legacy. He highlighted that the children are "incredibly amazing" and remain by his side during this new chapter.

Reactions from colleagues and community support

Several Hollywood colleagues left messages of condolence in the comments of the post, reinforcing the importance of taking care of physical and mental health.

Personal and professional impact

Washington, who retired from acting in 2023, had already mentioned in previous interviews that marriage and fatherhood changed his trajectory. He reiterated that, despite the loss, he remains grateful for the family he has by his side.

With information from TV Insider, E! News, Us Weekly.
